title: Isibhengezo sokuNgcwaba
intro: Khawucinge ngomlawuli onamandla ojikelezwe bubuqaqawuli, izikhumbuzo, nemikhosi ethobela umyalelo omnye. Lo mntu wathabatha igunya eliphezulu, wayilahla imiqondiso kaThixo njengenkohliso, waza wayalela ukuba kulandelelwe elwandle ngokungenalusini. Landela umkhondo ukusuka kwimithetho yokuzikhukhumeza ukuya emanzini ahlukeneyo, apho uvumo lokugqibela lufika emva kwexesha kakhulu ukuba lungasindiswa.
clues: Ndandinamandla apheleleyo kwaye ndabakhoboka abantwana bakwaSirayeli phantsi kolawulo lwam.
Ndazibiza ngokuba ndinguYehova ophakamileyo kwaye ndala ukuvuma nawuphi na uthixo ngaphezu kwam.
Ndayalela uHaman ukuba andakhele inqaba ephakamileyo ukuze ndijonge uThixo kaMoses.
Ndajongana noMusa noHarun xa bezisa imiqondiso ecacileyo, ndaza ndathi imimangaliso yabo bubugqwirha.
Ndamsukela uMusa namakholwa kunye nemikhosi yam ebusuku sada safika elwandle.
Ndathi ndiyakholelwa xa ndanditshona elwandle, kodwa kwase kudlule ixesha, umzimba wam wagcinwa njengophawu.
